subtasks.title: Show the leading kit's name on both leaderboard collapsed cards
subtasks.approach: Mirror the UniqueScansLeaderboard::toStat() pattern (app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/UniqueScansLeaderboard.php:228-239) on the two leaderboard cards that lack it. RecoveryLeader: capture leaderboardForSelectedRange() once into a local, add ->description('Top Kit: '.($leader['leader']['name'] ?? 'N/A')) and keep the existing headline number unchanged. StagingLiveHitLeader: replace collect(...)->max('total') with collect(...)->sortByDesc('total')->first() so the headline total and the name come from the SAME row, then add the same ->description(). Correct the RecoveryLeader::toStat() docblock, which currently documents the opposite. TDD: invert the RecoveryLeader assertions that pin name ABSENCE (leader now present, runner-up still absent) and ADD a name assertion for StagingLiveHitLeader plus a headline-parity assertion proving the value did not shift.

intended_diffs.app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/RecoveryL: toStat() (~:234-244): hoist $leaderboard = $this->leaderboardForSelectedRange(); reuse it for BOTH the headline number and a new ->description('Top Kit: '.($leaderboard['leader']['name'] ?? 'N/A')). The existing docblock at :234-238 claims 'no names ... were dropped so this card is the same height as its siblings' -- rewrite it in one or two sparse lines: the height cost is gone (theme.css:171 reserves description space on every card), leader name restored per DEV-2586, runner-up deliberately still omitted.
intended_diffs.app/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/StagingLi: toStat() (~:234-244): $leader = collect($this->leaderboardForSelectedRange())->sortByDesc('total')->first(); headline becomes number_format($leader['total'] ?? 0) -- numerically identical to today's max('total') -- plus ->description('Top Kit: '.($leader['name'] ?? 'N/A')).
intended_diffs.tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/Recover: Rework the assertNoLeaderboardCardNames() helper (:479) and its 6 call sites (:219,287,292,297,302,335) into an assertion that the LEADER name is in the Stat description and the runner-up is not. Rename test_collapsed_card_headlines_the_leader_count_without_the_names (:171). Re-evaluate test_collapsed_card_never_carries_long_kit_names (:308): a long name now renders, so assert the truncation behaviour rather than absence.
intended_diffs.tests/Filament/Widgets/Dashboard/Staging: ADD: the collapsed Stat description names the leading kit; and the headline value is byte-identical to the previous max('total') result for the same fixture (guards the max -> sortByDesc swap).
